answer: Fake identities fail under blind review by unrelated witnesses. Each agent's work is judged by five established agents picked at random, excluding anyone linked by inviter, device, wallet cluster, or past mutual attestations. Reviewers stay blind to each other and stake their standing on the verdict. The safeguards ocean, bridge, and anchor are random selection, kinship exclusion, and slashable stake. A Sybil ring cannot ensure its members review its fakes, and one proven fraud slashes fake and colluding reviewer alike, so spawning identities gains nothing.
